figs.name: functional-safety-assessment-five-stages-diagram
figs.alt: functional safety assessment five stages on the IEC 61511 safety lifecycle
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog placing the five FSA stages on the safety lifecycle: after risk analysis, at FAT, before startup, during operation and at every modification.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Five functional safety assessment stages along the IEC 61511 safety lifecycle</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5 FSA Stages Along the Safety Lifecycle</text>
<polygon points="20,150 156,150 170,190 156,230 20,230 34,190" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="95" y="184" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hazard and</text>
<text x="95" y="208" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">risk analysis</text>
<polygon points="174,150 310,150 324,190 310,230 174,230 188,190" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="249" y="184" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Design,</text>
<text x="249" y="208" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">FAT</text>
<polygon points="328,150 464,150 478,190 464,230 328,230 342,190" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="403" y="184" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Install,</text>
<text x="403" y="208" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">commission</text>
<polygon points="482,150 618,150 632,190 618,230 482,230 496,190" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="557" y="184" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Operate,</text>
<text x="557" y="208" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">maintain</text>
<polygon points="636,150 772,150 786,190 772,230 636,230 650,190" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="711" y="184" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Modify,</text>
<text x="711" y="208" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">MoC</text>
<line x1="95" y1="232" x2="95" y2="270" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="95" cy="290" r="22" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="95" y="297" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="95" y="344" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">SIL targets</text>
<text x="95" y="368" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">and SRS right?</text>
<line x1="249" y1="232" x2="249" y2="270" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="249" cy="290" r="22" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="249" y="297" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="249" y="344" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">design meets</text>
<text x="249" y="368" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the SRS?</text>
<line x1="403" y1="232" x2="403" y2="270" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="403" cy="290" r="22" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="403" y="297" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="403" y="344" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">pre startup</text>
<text x="403" y="368" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">safety review</text>
<line x1="557" y1="232" x2="557" y2="270" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="557" cy="290" r="22" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="557" y="297" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="557" y="344" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">periodic, since</text>
<text x="557" y="368" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Edition 2</text>
<line x1="711" y1="232" x2="711" y2="270" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<circle cx="711" cy="290" r="22" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="711" y="297" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<text x="711" y="344" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">every change,</text>
<text x="711" y="368" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">all software</text>
<text x="400" y="100" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Each stage is an independent review, not led by the design or O&M team</text>
<rect x="20" y="430" width="760" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="468" font-size="18" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Goal: catch systematic errors early and confirm the SIL</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">targets in the Safety Requirements Specification are met</text>
</svg>

figs.name: functional-safety-assessment-modification-flowchart
figs.alt: functional safety assessment flowchart for a plant modification under management of change
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing FSA stage 5: every change gets a safety impact analysis, all software changes are independently assessed and SIL impacts are rechecked.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart of a functional safety assessment for a modification</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">FSA Stage 5: Handling a Plant Change</text>
<rect x="250" y="56" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="90.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Change proposed</text>
<line x1="400" y1="112" x2="400" y2="132" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="250" y="132" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#c2410c" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="166.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Safety impact analysis</text>
<line x1="400" y1="188" x2="400" y2="208" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,210.0 570.0,260 400,310.0 230.0,260" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="255.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Software change,</text>
<text x="400" y="277.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">even a minor one?</text>
<line x1="570" y1="260" x2="610" y2="260" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="590" y="246" font-size="17" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="610" y="222" width="170" height="76" rx="10" fill="#7c2d12" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="695.0" y="254.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Independent</text>
<text x="695.0" y="278.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">assessment</text>
<line x1="400" y1="310" x2="400" y2="336" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="385" y="328" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">No</text>
<polygon points="400,338.0 570.0,388 400,438.0 230.0,388" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="383.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Could it affect</text>
<text x="400" y="405.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">the SIL targets?</text>
<line x1="570" y1="388" x2="610" y2="388" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="590" y="374" font-size="17" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="610" y="350" width="170" height="76" rx="10" fill="#7c2d12" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="695.0" y="382.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Reassess against</text>
<text x="695.0" y="405.45" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">the SRS</text>
<line x1="400" y1="438" x2="400" y2="464" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="456" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="250" y="464" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#f0fdf4" stroke="#16a34a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="500.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Implement and record</text>
<polyline points="695,426 695,494 552,494" fill="none" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polyline points="695,298 695,322 404,322" fill="none" stroke="#7c2d12" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="400" y="560" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">All software changes go through FSA 5, a point often overlooked</text>
</svg>

figs.name: functional-safety-assessment-benefits-infographic
figs.alt: functional safety assessment benefits and an FAT example where a logic solver error was caught
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog listing five reasons FSA matters and the article example where FSA stage 2 at FAT caught a logic solver error before reactor startup.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Why functional safety assessment is critical, with the FAT example</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Why FSA Matters</text>
<rect x="20" y="66" width="400" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="48" cy="95" r="16" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="48" y="101" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="76" y="91" font-size="18" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Accident prevention</text>
<text x="76" y="114" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">flaws caught before incidents</text>
<rect x="20" y="136" width="400" height="58" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="48" cy="165" r="16" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="48" y="171" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="76" y="161" font-size="18" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Regulatory compliance</text>
<text x="76" y="184" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">IEC 61511 requires FSAs</text>
<rect x="20" y="206" width="400" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="48" cy="235" r="16" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="48" y="241" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="76" y="231" font-size="18" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Cost savings</text>
<text x="76" y="254" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">cheaper to fix at FAT</text>
<rect x="20" y="276" width="400" height="58" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="48" cy="305" r="16" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="48" y="311" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="76" y="301" font-size="18" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Reputation and trust</text>
<text x="76" y="324" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">regulators, staff, public</text>
<rect x="20" y="346" width="400" height="58" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="48" cy="375" r="16" fill="#c2410c"/>
<text x="48" y="381" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<text x="76" y="371" font-size="18" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Operational reliability</text>
<text x="76" y="394" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">SIS stays valid over time</text>
<rect x="440" y="66" width="340" height="338" rx="14" fill="#7c2d12"/>
<text x="610" y="104" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Example from the article</text>
<text x="610" y="148" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">New reactor at a</text>
<text x="610" y="182" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">petrochemical plant</text>
<text x="610" y="216" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">FSA 2 at FAT found a</text>
<text x="610" y="250" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">logic solver error:</text>
<text x="610" y="284" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">no shutdown under some</text>
<text x="610" y="318" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">abnormal conditions</text>
<text x="610" y="352" font-size="18" fill="#fed7aa" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fixed before startup</text>
<rect x="20" y="430" width="760" height="100" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#c2410c" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="468" font-size="18" fill="#7c2d12" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Many accidents start from systematic failures:</text>
<text x="400" y="500" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">weak hazard analysis, poor specifications, software mistakes</text>
</svg>
